newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end slightly up in lethargic trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end slightly up in lethargic trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended lethargic trade slightly higher on Monday, in the aftermath of the turbulence in the New York stock market. Some investors bargain-hunted after sharp sell-offs in Tokyo last week, which made brokers expect trade to be range-bound for the rest of the year.
The key 225-issue Nikkei average was up 80.65 points, or 0.40 percent, to finish at 20,422.04. Its March futures added 110 points to 20,420.
"It was directionless trade, with nothing to trade on actively," said Tetsuya Ishijima, chief strategist at Okasan Securities Co Ltd.
